description: This file manages the Wi-Fi SSID configuration UI, including loading, editing, validation, and saving SSID settings for a wireless device.

methods.name: page_init
methods.description: Initializes the page with SSID data, creating a list of SSID nodes for display.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful retrieval of SSID configuration data, copies data and initializes page.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed data retrieval, stops loading indicator.

methods.name: get_obj_data
methods.description: Fetches SSID configuration data from API.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Starts the process of loading SSID data.

methods.name: ssid_enable_control
methods.description: Enables or disables an SSID based on checkbox state.

methods.name: hide_control_bar
methods.description: Hides or shows the control bar for SSID settings.

methods.name: ssid_control
methods.description: Handles the display of detailed SSID control options.

methods.name: _node_control
methods.description: Displays detailed control options for a specific SSID node.

methods.name: hide_handler
methods.description: Sets the hidden status of an SSID.

methods.name: select_authtype_select
methods.description: Updates the authentication type for an SSID.

methods.name: valid_key
methods.description: Validates the WPA key for an SSID.

methods.name: set_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback after successfully saving SSID configuration.

methods.name: set_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for errors during save operation.

methods.name: set_obj_data
methods.description: Sends updated SSID data to API for saving.

methods.name: page_save
methods.description: Validates and saves the current SSID configuration.
